description: Boundary coverage for plain many-to-many batched loading. Concurrent owner-side collection getters issued within one tick are folded into a single underlying round-trip whose filter carries the union of owner keys, and the rows are de-multiplexed back per owner. The reported signals are the number of round-trips, the owner-key set folded into each round-trip, and the linked-record id set returned to each owner, including owners that have no links at all and owners requested more than once in the same wave.
